senses.gloss: प्र-पश्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, foreseeing, looking.
प्रपश्यत् प्र-पश्यत्. See प्र-दृश्, p. 631.

प्रपक्ष प्र-पक्ष, अस्, m. the extremity of
a wing (of an army drawn out in the form of a
bird); (अस्, आ, अम्), forming the extremity of a wing
(in an army so arranged).

प्रपच् प्र-पच्, cl. 1. P. A. -पचति, -ते, -पक्-
तुम्, to begin to cook; to be accustomed to cook.
प्र-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम्, (in medicine) inflamed.

प्र-पाक, अस्, m. ripening (of a boil &c.); in-
flammation.
प्रपाक प्र-पाक. See प्र-पच्, p. 632.

प्रापक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to arrive at, leading
to (with gen.), conveying, bringing; causing to obtain,
providing with, procuring; a procurer; establishing,
making valid; obtaining, one who obtains.

प्रपञ्च प्र-पञ्च, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. पच् or
पञ्च् with प्र), spreading out, development, dif-
fusion, display, amplification, expansion; expanse, ex-
tent; (in philosophy) the expansion of the universe,
the world as the scene of manifold action, the visible
world or universe; prolixity, diffuseness, copiousness
(in style or composition); heap, abundance, quantity;
manifoldness, diversity; phenomenon, appearance;
illusion, delusion, deceit, trick, fraud, error; reci-
procal false praise; reverse, opposition, reversion,
inversion; analysis; (in grammar) the repetition of
an obscure rule in a clearer form; a joke, jest (?);
(as an enclitic after a finite verb) see Gaṇa Gotrādi
to Pāṇ. VIII. 1, 27, 57; प्रपञ्चेन or प्रपञ्च-
तस्, ind. diffusely, in detail.
—प्रपञ्च-निर्माण,
अम्, n. the creation of the visible world.
—प्रपञ्च-
बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, deceitful-minded, artful, cunning;
(इस्), m., N. of a man.
—प्रपञ्च-वचन, अम्,
n. a diffuse or prolix discourse.
—प्रपञ्च-विवेक
and प्रपञ्च-सार, अस्, m., N. of two works.

प्र-पञ्चक, अस्, इका, अम्, developing, displaying;
explaining, copiously expounding.

प्र-पञ्चन, अम्, n. development, display, diffu-
sion; copious explanation or exposition, explication.

प्रपञ्चय, Nom. P. प्रपञ्चयति, -यितुम्,
to develop, amplify; to display, explain in detail,
analyze; to dwell upon a note (in music); to cause
to appear in a false light.

प्रपञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Nom.), amplified,
expanded, extended, diffused; declared fully, ex-
plained, expatiated upon, treated at length; caused
to appear in a false light; mistaken, erring; tricked,
deceived, beguiled.

प्रपठ् प्र-पठ्, cl. 1. P. -पठति, -पठितुम्,
to recite aloud: Caus. -पाठयति, -यितुम्, to teach,
lecture, expound.

प्र-पाठक, अस्, m. a lesson, lecture, a division,
chapter or subdivision of a book (sometimes read
प्र-पाठ).
प्रपाठक प्र-पाठक. See प्र-पठ्, p. 632.

प्रपण प्र-पण, अस्, m., Ved. (fr. rt. 2. पण्
with प्र), exchange, barter.

प्रापण, अम्, n. attaining to, attainment, reach-
ing, extending, (बाह्वोः प्रापणान्ते, as far as the
arms reach); obtaining, receiving, acquisition; bring-
ing to, leading to, conveying; procuring [cf. दुष्-
प्रापण]; reference to.

प्रपत् प्र-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्,
to fly forwards, fly along, fly forth, fly away; to
hasten forwards, hasten away; to fly down, rush or
dart down; to fall down, fall; to fall into; to come
to; to fall from, be deprived of, lose (with abl.):
Caus. -पातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fly away, put
to flight; to chase, pursue: Desid. -पिपतिषति,
Ved. to wish to hurry away: Intens. -पापतीति, Ved.
to shoot forth; (Sāy.) = पुनः पुनः पत्, to fall
again and again, descend repeatedly.

प्र-पतन, अम्, n. flying forwards, flying forth,
flying away; falling, falling down or into, precipi-
tating one's self from; alighting; dying, death,
destruction; a steep rock, precipice.

प्र-पातन, अम्, n. the causing to fall, throwing
down, throwing on the ground; अक्ष-प्रपातन,
throwing dice.

प्र-पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, flown forwards, flown
away, flown; fallen, come down; decayed, dead.

प्र-पात, अस्, m. a particular mode of flying;
starting off, hastening away, going away, departure;
springing forth, sudden attack, facing an enemy;
falling down or into, a fall; precipitating one's self
down from a rock; falling out, (दन्त-केश-प्रपात,
the falling out or loss of the teeth and hair); discharge,
emission, flux [cf. वीर्य-प्˚]; a steep rock, cliff,
precipice; a steep bank or shore; a cascade, water-
fall.
—प्रपाताभिमुख (˚त-अभ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्,
inclined to precipitate one's self from a rock.
—प्रपाताम्बु (˚त-अम्˚), उ, n. falling water,
water falling from a rock.

प्र-पातिन्, ई, m. a precipitous mountain, moun-
tain, rock, cliff.

प्र-पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to de-
scend or alight, wishing to fall or throw one's self down.

प्र-पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of attaining, de-
sirous of entering upon.
प्रपित्सु प्र-पित्सु. See under 1. प्र-पद्.

प्रपथ प्र-पथ, अस्, m., Ved. a long way
or journey, a journey to a distant place; a remote
place; a broad road or street; (अस्, आ, अम्), loose,
relaxed, languid, enervated.
प्रपाथ, अस्, m. a road, way.

प्रपथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. roaming on distant
paths (Sāy. = प्रकृष्ट-मार्ग); (ई), m., N. of a
man (?).

प्रपथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in the streets
or on the road (Mahī-dhara = बहु-सेवितो मार्गस्
तत्र भवः, being in a much frequented road); an
epithet of Pūṣan, the tutelary deity of travellers.

प्रपद् 1. प्र-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्-
तुम्, to go forwards, set out for, betake one's self
to, resort to; to attain to, arrive at, reach; to take
refuge with, flee to for safety, fly to for succour; to
enter upon, enter into, set foot on; to come to a par-
ticular state, arrive at a condition; to become (with
adv. ending in सात्, e. g. सर्प-सात् प्रपद्, to become
a serpent); to attain, obtain, gain, partake of, share
in; to perceive; to come on, draw near, approach,
appear (said of periods of time); to be going on, to
proceed; to take effect, prosper; to deal with, act
towards, behave towards; to allow, admit, assent, agree
to; to throw one's self down, fall down (at another's
feet); to fall upon, attack, assault, assail (Ved.);
अध्वानम् प्रपद्, to set forth on the way, begin
a journey; जिन-शाशनम् प्रपद्, to embrace the
doctrines of Jina: Caus. P. A. -पादयति, -ते, -यि-
तुम्, to cause to enter, introduce: Desid. P. A.
-पित्सति, -ते, to wish to enter; to desire to obtain;
to be going to undertake.

2. प्र-पद्, त्, f., Ved. a way; N. of particular sacred
texts; (fr. प्र + 3. पद्), the fore part of the foot.

प्र-पाद, अस्, m., Ved. premature delivery, mis-
carriage.
प्र-पदन, अम्, n. entering, entrance.

प्रपदम्, ind. a term applied to a particular mode
of recitation (in which the Vedic verses are divided,
without reference to the sense and construction, into
parts of an equal number of syllables, and between
these parts particular formulas inserted containing the
word प्र-पद्ये).

प्रपदीन, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the fore part
of the foot; extending to it, (wrongly for आप्रप-
दीन, q. v.)

प्र-पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, arriving at, reaching;
seeking, adhering to; one who seeks for protection
or takes refuge, a suppliant; attained, obtained; pos-
sessed of, furnished with, provided with; promised,
assented to; effecting, producing; poor, distressed.
—प्रपन्न-पाल, अस्, m. ‘the protector of sup-
pliants or of those who seek protection,’ an epithet
of Kṛṣṇa.
—प्रपन्नामृत (˚न-अम्˚), अम्, n.
‘nectar for suppliants,’ N. of a work.
—प्रपन्-
नार्ति-हर (˚न-आर्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, relieving or re-
liever of the distress of suppliants.
प्रपन्न प्र-पन्न. See above.

प्र-पान, अम्, n. drinking, sipping; the under part
of a horse's upper lip (which he uses in drinking).

प्र-पादुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. going off, coming
forth.
प्रपादुक प्र-पादुक. See under 1. प्र-पद्.
प्रपन्नाड प्रपन्नाड, अस्, m. = प्रपुन्नाड.
प्रपर्ण प्र-पर्ण, अस्, m. a fallen leaf.

प्रपलाय प्र-पलाय, cl. 1. A. -पलायते,
-यितुम्, to run away, flee away, escape.
प्र-पलायन, अम्, n. running away, flight, rout.

प्र-पलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, run away; routed,
defeated.

प्र-पलायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, running away, flying,
escaping; a fugitive, one who deserts his cause.

प्रपवण प्र-पवण or प्र-पवन, अम्, n.
(rt. 1. पू), purifying, straining (Soma juice).

प्र-पवणीय or प्र-पवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्,
to be cleansed or purified.

प्रपा 1. प्र-पा (see rt. 1. पा), cl. 1. P.
-पिबति (Ved. -पाति), -पातुम्, to begin to drink,
drink, quaff, sip; (with चक्षुषा) to drink in
with the eyes, feast the eyes upon.

2. प्र-पा, f. (according to the usual rule the nom.
sing. would be प्र-पास्), a place for watering cattle,
a shed on the road-side for accommodating travellers
with water, place where water is distributed, cistern,
(according to Kullūka = पानीय-दान-गृह); a
draught; a supply of water.
—प्रपा-पूरण, अम्,
n. filling a place for watering cattle, furnishing a
cistern with water.
—प्रपापूरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्,
serving to fill a cistern.
—प्रपा-वन, अम्, n.
‘cistern-grove,’ a pleasure-garden, a cool grove.

प्रपा 3. प्र-पा (see rt. 3. पा), cl. 2. P.
-पाति, -पातुम्, to protect, defend from (with abl.):
Caus. -पालयति, -यितुम्, to guard, screen, defend,
protect.

1. प्राप, अस्, m. (for 2. see p. 658), arriving at,
reaching, attaining, obtaining; [cf. दुष्-प्˚.]

प्राप 2. प्राप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र + अप्),
abounding with water, watery (?).

प्र-पाणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be drunk, drinkable,
potable.

प्रापणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attained to, to be
reached, attainable; to be caused to attain, to be
made to arrive at; to be provided with; to be pro-
cured, procurable, obtainable.
प्रपानक, अम्, n. (probably) a draught, beverage.
1. प्र-पायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, drinking, one who drinks.
2. प्र-पायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, protecting (?).

प्र-पालन, अम्, n. guarding, protecting, pro-
tection.

प्र-पालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, guarding, protecting; (ई),
m. an epithet of Bala-rāma.

प्रपाणि प्र-पाणि, इस्, m. the flat or palm of
the hand.

प्रपाण्डु प्र-पाण्डु, उस्, उस्, उ, very white,
of a dazzling white colour.
प्र-पाण्डुर, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्र-पाण्डु.

प्रपादिक प्रपादिक, अस्, m. a peacock;
(also read प्रपादीक.)

प्रपितामह प्र-पितामह, अस्, m. a paternal
great-grandfather; an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (regarded
as great-grandfather of the three worlds); an epithet
of Brahmā; (ई), f. a paternal great-grandmother;
(आस्), m. pl. great-grandfathers, ancestors in general.
प्र-पितृव्य, अस्, m. a paternal grand-uncle.

प्रपित्व प्र-पित्व, अम्, n., Ved. going
towards, going to meet, meeting with, encountering
(Sāy. = सङ्ग्राम, combat); the coming on or ap-
proach of day, day-break (Sāy. = प्र-क्रम); [cf.
अप-पित्व, अभि-पित्व.]

प्रपिन्व् प्र-पिन्व्, cl. 1. P. A. -पिन्वति,
-ते, -पिन्वितुम्, Ved. to swell, be full of, be rich,
flow over.

प्रपिष् प्र-पिष्, cl. 7. P. -पिनष्टि, -पेष्-
टुम्, to crush, pound: Caus. -पेषयति, -यितुम्,
to pound, grind or crush to pieces.

प्र-पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, pounded, ground or crushed
to pieces.

प्रपीड् प्र-पीड्, Caus. -पीडयति, -यितुम्, to
press hard, press, squeeze; to check, suppress; to
oppress, molest, injure, pain, torment, torture.

प्र-पीडन, अम्, n. pressing, squeezing; (in
medicine) an astringent.

प्र-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed, oppressed; pained,
tortured.
प्रपीत प्र-पीत, प्र-पीन. See col. 3.

प्र-पीत or प्र-पीन, अस्, आ, अम्, swollen out,
swollen up, distended.

प्रापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to attain to, made
to arrive at; caused to occupy, placed upon; led or
conducted to, brought to, conveyed; promoted or
advanced to, appointed to; caused to obtain or gain,
caused to possess; procured.

प्रपुत्र प्र-पुत्र, अस्, m. a grandson, de-
scendant.

प्रपुनाट प्रपुनाट, or प्रपुनाड, or प्र-
[]
पुन्नड, or प्रपुन्नाट, or प्रपुन्नाड, or
प्रपुन्नाल, अस्, m. a species of tree, Cassia Tora;
the ringworm shrub, Cassia Alata.

प्रपुष् प्र-पुष्, cl. 4. 9. P. -पुष्यति,
-पुष्णाति, -पोषितुम्, to nourish, feed, support,
maintain.

प्रपुष्पित प्र-पुष्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, flowering,
in blossom, blooming.

प्रपूज् प्र-पूज्, cl. 10. P. -पूजयति, -यितुम्,
to show respect or honour to, praise, esteem, honour.

प्रपृ प्र-पृ (see rt. 1. पृ), Caus. P. -पा-
रयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to carry across, bring over,
transport, ferry over; to bring out of, to deliver
from (with abl.), rescue, protect (Sāy. = पालयति).

प्रपॄ प्र-पॄ, cl. 9. P. -पृणाति, -परितुम्,
-परीतुम्, to fill up, complete: Pass. -पूर्यते, to
be filled, become full, become satiated; to be com-
pleted, be fulfilled: Caus. -पूरयति, -यितुम्, to
fill up, complete; to make rich, enrich.

प्रपृच् प्र-पृच्, cl. 7. P. -पृणक्ति, -पर्चि-
तुम्, Ved. to come in contact with (with acc.).

प्रपृथक् प्र-पृथक्, ind., Ved. singly, one
by one.

प्रपृष्ठ प्र-पृष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
prominent or protuberant back.

प्र-पूरक, अस्, इका, अम्, filling up, fulfilling,
satisfying, satiating; (इका), f. the plant Solanum
Jacquini.

प्र-पूरण, अस्, ई, अम्, filling, fulfilling, satisfying;
(अम्), n. the act of filling up, filling; injecting, injec-
tion, inserting; affixing, attaching to; satiating, satis-
fying; (with धनुषः) bending a bow, i. e. the
drawing or filling out of a bow-string for the purpose
of shooting.
प्र-पूरित, अस्, आ, अम्, filled up, completed.

प्रपौण्डरीक प्रपौण्डरीक, अम्, n. a small
herbaceous plant (= पौण्डरीक, commonly पुण्-
डरिया, used as a remedy for ulcers and bad eyes
and as a perfume); = स्थल-पद्म, Hibiscus Mu-
tabilis.

प्रपौत्र प्र-पौत्र or प्र-पौत्रक, अस्, m.
the son of a son's son, a great-grandson; (ई), f. the
daughter of a son's son, a great-granddaughter.

प्रप्यै प्र-प्यै, cl. 1. A. -प्यायते, -प्यायि-
तुम्, -प्यातुम्, to swell out, swell up, be distended:
Caus. -प्याययति, -यितुम्, to cause to swell out,
swell, distend.

प्र-प्यात or प्र-प्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, swollen
out, distended, fat, bulky.

प्र-प्यायन, अम्, n. causing to swell out,
swelling.

प्र-प्यायनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to swell
out, to be swollen.

प्र-प्याययितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. causing to
swell out, distending.

प्रप्रोथ प्र-प्रोथ, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?),
Ved. a particular plant (sometimes used as a substi-
tute for the Soma plant).

प्रप्लु प्र-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लोतुम्,
Ved. to swim towards, to float or sail away: Caus.
-प्लावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to float or sail away;
to pour water upon, wash or flood with water.

प्र-प्लावन, अम्, n., Ved. flooding with water,
extinguishing (a fire) with water.
प्र-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. dipped in water.

प्राप् 1. प्राप् (प्र-आप्), cl. 5. P. A. प्राप्-
नोति, प्राप्नुते, प्राप्तुम्, to attain to, reach,
arrive at; to extend, stretch; to come upon, light
upon, meet with, find; to obtain, get, gain, win;
to obtain as a husband or wife; to bring upon
one's self, contract, incur (e. g. दण्डम् प्राप्, to
incur a fine); to suffer, endure (e. g. वधम् प्राप्,
to suffer capital punishment); to flee to (e. g. दिशः
प्रापन्, they fled to the various quarters, i. e. they
fled in all directions); to pass or be changed into
(in gram.), to follow (a grammatical rule); to be
present, be at hand (Ved.): Caus. प्रापयति, -ते,
-यितुम्, to cause to attain to, cause to reach or
arrive at, cause to occupy; to lead to, bring to;
to promote or advance to, appoint to (an office); to
drive to; to cause to obtain or gain, cause to possess,
give anything to any one (with two acc.); to tell,
announce (Rāmāyaṇa VII. 103, 10): Desid. प्रेप्-
सति, to try to attain or get at, strive to reach.
2. प्राप्, प्, प्, प्, (at the end of a comp.) obtaining.
प्रापय्य, ind. = 2. प्राप्य, q. v.

प्रापिन्, ई, इणी, इ, attaining to, reaching, coming
to; obtaining, getting, gaining, receiving.

प्राप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, attained to, reached, arrived
at [cf. कर-प्˚, हस्त-प्˚]; come upon, lighted
upon, met with, found; obtained, got, gained,
[]
acquired, procured, won; incurred, contracted; suf-
fered, endured; one who has attained to or arrived
at; arrived, come, present; come to a close, com-
pleted, arrived at maturity; (in gram.) obtained
from a rule, following from a rule, valid in conse-
quence of a rule (e. g. इति प्राप्ते, because it so
follows from a preceding rule); (in medicine) de-
scribed (as a symptom); fixed, placed; proper, right;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
—प्राप्त-कारिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, doing what is fit or proper.
—प्राप्त-काल,
अस्, m. a time or moment arrived, a favourable
moment, a fit time, proper season; (अस्, आ, अम्),
one whose time has come (e. g. प्राप्त-कालो देही,
a mortal whose time, i. e. whose last hour, is come);
opportune, seasonable, suitable; arrived at maturity,
marriageable; fated, destined; (अम्), ind. at the
right time, opportunely.
